description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka Estimated expenditure for the year 2020
categorisation: This gazette content presents the estimated expenditure and performance goals of the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka for the year 2020 across electricity, petroleum, and water sectors. It contains budgetary information and operational targets but does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio assignments. The content does not fit any specialized categories (4-9) as it is not about land, legal/regulatory matters, commerce, elections, public service, or judicial/law enforcement. It represents administrative planning for public utilities, making it fall under Miscellaneous (Type 10).
